old_problem: Procedure requires the selected HPM hub and all children, while Criteria permits PASS on hub detection alone. Another hub or an empty HPM hub can therefore pass. The HPM slot/board population and exact root-port route are also unspecified.
disposition_reason: The acceptance scopes are materially inconsistent and no approved rule allows dropping downstream coverage. A parameterized read-only collection can preserve both result sets, but only the test-spec owner can decide whether missing HPM children fail. Until that ruling, PASS/FAIL is not authoritative and Pending remains.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2170, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2171 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00058-V003 / 458462f71c18b2ff was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Engineer must resolve hub-only versus exact hub-plus-all-downstream acceptance; evidence collection preserves both scopes.
Bind target HPM slot/PN/revision/population, BMC root-port/connectors/cable/hub and authoritative enumeration surface.
Freeze exact hub path/VID:PID/product/serial/speed and per-port downstream manifest with N/A/missing/unexpected policy.
Operator verifies/photographs the populated HPM and physical route; capture complete unfiltered tree/descriptors and reset/flap/error evidence.
No generic hub substitution, insecure/truncated collection, replug, reset, rebind, authorization or HPM power action/retry.
No query, physical manipulation, USB/HPM state change, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: HPM-bound BMC USB hub and complete downstream topology reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Prove the physical/logical BMC-to-selected-HPM USB path, exact hub and complete downstream population while preserving both conflicting source acceptance scopes.
required_package: Acceptance ruling for exact hub only versus hub plus all downstream devices
Target HPM slot/PN/revision/population and BMC root-port/connector/hub map
Authoritative enumeration surface and frozen hub/per-port child identity/speed manifest
Operator physical path/photos and complete USB descriptor/log access
Population/N/A, reset/error limits, abort and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending Engineering Decision. Operator proves the selected HPM and path. On the authoritative surface collect complete unfiltered USB tree, hub and child descriptors, speeds and reset/error history; compare exact hub and every manifest child separately and report both acceptance scopes without altering USB/HPM state.
test_case.expected_result: The exact selected-HPM hub and physical route are proven, every child is classified present/missing/unexpected/moved/downgraded, and no reset/flap or BMC/HPM fault occurs; final PASS awaits the approved scope.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while source scopes conflict. Apply the future ruling to the exact hub and, if Procedure coverage is retained, every child. Wrong HPM/route/hub, missing required child or limit breach is FAIL under the applicable scope; missing ruling is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED for verdict until acceptance scope, HPM identity/topology and manifest are signed.
Read-only collection only; operator verifies physical route without replug.
No reset, deauthorize, rebind, power action, generic match or retry.
Stop on wrong HPM, reset storm, flapping, downgrade or management instability.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and conflict disposition
BMC-to-HPM root-port/connector/hub map and authoritative enumeration proof
Complete tree/descriptors/speeds and frozen per-port manifest comparison
Pre/post USB reset/flap/error and BMC/HPM health evidence
Separate hub-only/full-downstream outcomes, recovery record and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on instability. Leave the HPM management path unchanged and use only approved recovery; do not replug, reset, rebind, power-cycle or retry to alter the result.

source_conflict.reason: Procedure requires all downstream devices; Criteria declares PASS from hub detection alone, allowing an incompletely functional HPM to pass.

blocked.reason: Both evidence scopes are collectable, but authoritative acceptance remains Engineering Decision Pending.
